findings: Reviewed AS phenotype distinctions, dynamic/CT confirmation, timing and modality questions and AR severity/intervention distinctions
Revised surgical-modality and concomitant-aorta distractors to compare more relevant planning choices
Revised hypertension distractors to assess treatment purpose and continued valve surveillance
Confirmed amlodipine 5 mg daily initial and 10 mg maximum adult dose against prescribing information
Reviewed morphology, flow/rate dependence, postcommissurotomy PHT limitations, exercise thresholds, balloon eligibility, thrombus reassessment, anticoagulation, pregnancy and MAC mechanisms
Replaced unrelated exercise-investigation options with TEE planimetry and CPET alternatives
Compared balloon intervention with open surgical commissurotomy rather than an unrelated regurgitation procedure
Replaced pregnancy ACE inhibitor distractor with a competing delivery strategy; clarified persistent symptomatic disease versus controlled disease
Reviewed primary versus atrial/ventricular MR, quantification limitations, Carpentier motion, acute rupture and primary MR LV criteria
Added complete ESC 2025 Table 7 ventricular-SMR TEER selection domains with exact EF, diameter, pressure, natriuretic peptide and HF-event thresholds
Improved surgical repair distractors to compare actual chordal-sparing replacement and TEER strategies
Replaced post-TEER extra-device distractor with a plausible but insufficient PHT-based assessment
Retained separate COAPT/MITRA-FR/RESHAPE endpoints and rate versus percentage distinctions
Reviewed lead-related mechanism, integrated TR severity, referral timing, concomitant repair, transcatheter benefit attribution, TS and pulmonary intervention
Made RHC wording consistent across TR intervention explanations
Replaced pulmonary branch stenting distractor with surgical valvotomy
Rewrote chronic PR distractors as competing surveillance thresholds within repaired tetralogy
Rechecked ESC 2025 severe TS mean gradient >5 mmHg at normal rate and original TRILUMINATE one-year hierarchical result
Reviewed prosthesis selection, position-specific INR, device-specific reduced INR, failed DOAC evidence, early bioprosthetic VKA and low-risk interruption
Confirmed ACC/AHA 2020 targets, On-X timing and aspirin qualifications and individualized higher-risk bridging
Replaced coronary calcium scoring and PHT tissue-discrimination distractors with relevant Doppler and invasive hemodynamic alternatives
Replaced mechanical valve-in-valve distractor with inadequate anticoagulation-only stabilization in shock
Aligned biological thrombosis options as actual management strategies and improved early VKA duration distractor
Reviewed PVL, valve-in-valve, pregnancy anticoagulation and preconception intervention, perioperative sequence, prophylaxis, NBTE, carcinoid and multivalve sequence
Replaced pregnancy DOAC distractor with aPTT versus anti-Xa monitoring distinction
Specified first-line oral prophylaxis to distinguish standard amoxicillin from an allergy alternative; added the full AHA high-risk group framework
Replaced absolute simultaneous-treatment language with competing procedure schedules requiring reassessment

coverageReview.finding: Seven contiguous sections and 67 distinct mapped decisions; added chronic pulmonary regurgitation during gap review. Counts are editorial, not official examination weights.
coverageReview.crossChapterReview: Compared all decision labels in Cardiology 1 and 2. Generic hemodynamic concepts are supporting context here; acute MR question uses degenerative chordal rupture rather than repeating the post-infarct papillary rupture decision. No duplicate stem or decision requires removal.
coverageReview.limitations: Source-checked educational authoring and editorial review; not independently clinician-reviewed or authenticated past examination questions.
